प्रश्न (हिंदी संस्करण): गंगा Plain has been described as a :
questions.explanationEn:
Geosyncline is an obsolete concept which means linear trough 
of subsidence of the Earth's crust within which vast amounts 
of sediment accumulate. Ganga Plain can be best described 
as a geosyncline. Peneplain means a more or less level land 
surface produced by erosion over a long period. Pediplain is 
a broad, relatively flat rock surface formed by the joining of 
several pediments. Pediplains are usually formed in arid or 
semi-arid climates and may have a thin veneer of sediments. 
Karst plain can be best described as limestone plain.
questions.explanationHi:

विस्तृत हिंदी विवरण:

of subsidence of the Earth's crust within which vast amounts 
of sediment accumulate. Ganga Plain can be best described 
as a geosyncline. Peneplain means a more or less level land 
surface produced by erosion over a long period. Pediplain is 
a broad, relatively flat rock surface formed by the joining of

are found in them. The rocks of the Gondwana sequence 
were formed long after the rocks of the Vindhya sequence. 
Most of India's coal is obtained from the Gondwana region 
only. The coal of this area is of high graded. Maximum 
Bituminous coal is obtained here.

Uttarakhand, Sikkim, अरुणाचल प्रदेश, Meghalaya, 
Nagaland, Manipur, Mizoram, Tripura & 2 UTs - Jammu and 
Kashmir and Ladakh and hill regions of 2 states viz. Assam 
and पश्चिम बंगाल. On the other hand the expansion of Uttar 
Pradesh lies only in the plain regions. So the Himalayan 
Mountain Ranges are not a part of उत्तर प्रदेश .
